products.title: Velvet Rose Romance
products.subtitle: Deep Crimson & Blush Velvet Stems

products.stems: 5x Mini Daisies, 3x Plush Chenille Strawberries, Ceramic Clay Pot included

reviews.name: Devika Mohan
reviews.comment: I ordered the Rose Romance bouquet for my sister's birthday in Kakkanad. The velvet chenille texture is so lush and soft to touch! She keeps it on her study desk and the rosewater aroma is still fragrant after 6 weeks. Real flowers wilt in two days in Kerala humidity, but this is forever.

reviews.name: Arjun & Sneha
reviews.comment: Customized a 7-stem pastel tulip bouquet through the Bouquet Bar. The cylindrical gift packaging arrived in mint condition via Speed Post with zero petal bending. My wife was genuinely stunned by the artistry and the handwritten calligraphy card.

reviews.name: Fathima S.
reviews.comment: Gifted my best friend for her graduation ceremony. Everyone thought they were fresh exotic flowers until they touched the velvety pipe cleaners! The artisan was so kind on WhatsApp helping me select the baby's breath accents. 10/10 recommend!
